treatment_plan.definitive: After root canal treatment for tooth 37, the crown was restored, and tooth 38 was extracted. The patient was informed of the course of treatment, related risks and costs, and the patient requested consideration.
treatment_plan.notes: After first wearing conventional invisible braces, doctor’s advice is to wear them for more than 22 hours a day. Wear each brace for 7 days before replacing it with the next one. Brush your teeth before wearing braces. Use chewing gum correctly after wearing braces. Oral hygiene education. Follow-up visit after two months. If you feel uncomfortable. Follow up.
